title: New driver causes crashes
symptom: PC started crashing after a new graphics driver was installed
user_description: I updated the graphics driver yesterday because a pop-up told me to. Since then the screen flickers and the PC crashes when I open my presentations.

options.why: Far too drastic when one recent driver change is the likely cause.
The card worked fine before the update, so the hardware is probably not the problem.

options.text: Disable the graphics device for good
options.why: Leaves the PC without proper graphics and does not fix anything.

options.text: Open Device Manager, choose the device and use Roll Back Driver (use Safe Mode if Windows will not stay up), then hold back that driver version until a fixed one is released
options.why: Rolling back returns to the driver that worked. Holding back the new version stops it reinstalling and crashing again.

hints: What changed just before the crashes started?
Can Windows go back to the previous driver?
How can you stop the same driver coming back?
real_world_tip: If Roll Back Driver is greyed out, there is no previous version saved. Install the last known good driver from the manufacturer instead.
